items.difficulty_reason: The lemma is the projection formula Rf_*E tensor^L K = Rf_*(E tensor^L Lf^*K) for a perfect coefficient object K (statement lines 13682-13693). The proof is a chain of explicit reductions rather than a computation: locality of the isomorphism makes K strictly perfect, additivity in K reduces to a finite complex of finite free modules, and a stupid-truncation argument together with invariance under finite direct summands reduces the statement to K = O_D[n], where it is trivial (proof lines 13696-13711). The non-formal content is the bookkeeping that each reduction is reversible, since the trivial case alone proves nothing. The claim is H2: a reduction chain, written out in full and using only standard permanence properties of perfect objects.
